declared_launch_environment.parsing: Read text only; this function does not execute the shell script.
known_launch_lines: sim) exec ros2 launch limo_sim_bringup sim.launch.py world:="$PWD/worlds/smoke_maze.world" headless:=true ;;

navigation) exec ros2 launch limo_maze_bringup mapping_navigation.launch.py nav_params:="$PWD/src/limo_maze_bringup/config/nav2_rpp.yaml" slam_params:="$PWD/src/limo_maze_bringup/config/slam_smoke_experimental.yaml" ;;

recorder) exec ros2 bag record --output "$run_dir/inputs-bag" --storage mcap --storage-preset-profile zstd_fast --max-bag-size 268435456 --use-sim-time --disable-keyboard-controls --node-name run15_input_recorder --qos-profile-overrides-path outputs/setup/run15-bag-qos.yaml --topics /scan /tf /tf_static /odom /clock /pose /map /plan /received_global_plan /lookahead_point /lookahead_collision_arc /is_rotating_to_heading /global_costmap/costmap_raw /local_costmap/costmap_raw /cmd_vel_nav /cmd_vel_smoothed /cmd_vel /rosout /mission/status /mission/map_epoch /mission/targets /mission/target_observations /mission/frame_processing /camera/color/image_raw /camera/depth/image_raw /camera/color/camera_info /camera/depth/camera_info ;;
perception) exec ros2 run limo_maze_perception red_rgbd_detector --ros-args -p use_sim_time:=true -p enabled:=true -p depth_registered_to_color:=true -p publish_frame_processing:=true ;;

mission) exec ros2 run limo_maze_mission mission --ros-args -p use_sim_time:=true -p autonomous:=true -p require_processed_inspection:=true -p initial_clearance_radius_m:=0.30 -p initial_clearance_source:=smoke_world_sha256_1ef2017583d448e36fb35825bbef6735536c2fe3cbf3a7a57380cf365c708811 -p mission_timeout_s:=900.0 -p return_timeout_s:=240.0 -p goal_timeout_s:=120.0 -p output_dir:="$run_dir/mission" ;;

limitations: Static configuration hashes do not establish effective ROS parameters; collect parameter dumps separately.
Collector module imports identify resolution under its current environment, not Python module files introspected inside an already running process.
File hashes describe files at capture time, not independently attested startup bytes.
Library records require /proc maps membership; on-disk file identity and stability are reported separately.
Processes can start or exit during this non-atomic snapshot; missing live libraries are not proof that a component never ran.
Project-path matches without the run token or validated PID/start_ticks remain explicitly unverified for run15 ownership.
No detector quality, visual coverage or whole-mission success is inferred.
